latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4575
* Bump antora from 3.2.0-alpha.12 to 3.2.0-rc.2 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4577
* Ignore release-train workflow updates in Dependabot by @ryanjbaxter in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4582
* Bump @springio/antora-extensions from 1.14.12 to 1.14.13 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4583
* Bump antora from 3.2.0-rc.2 to 3.2.0-rc.3 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4590
* Update Maven wrapper to 3.9.16 by @spring-builds in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4587
* Bump antora from 3.2.0-rc.3 to 3.2.0 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4596
* Fix TLS configuration for WebClient Eureka transport by @yashdotdev13 in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4603
* Update Antora UI bundle to v0.4.26 by @spring-builds in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4604
* Update Maven wrapper to 3.10.0 by @spring-builds in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4609
* Bump jersey.version from 4.0.2 to 4.0.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4612
* Encode instance ids in RestClient getInstance requests by @kdelay in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4614
* Bump @antora/atlas-extension from 1.0.0-alpha.5 to 1.0.0-alpha.6 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4620
* Bump antora from 3.2.0 to 3.2.1 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4619
* Keep Eureka credentials when the password contains a colon by @kdelay in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4621

## New Contributors
* @kdelay made their first contribution in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/pull/4614

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-netflix/compare/v5.0.2...v5.0.3

Documentation: changing Eureka renewal frequency *WILL* break the self-preservation feature of the server
